Low Temp Dabs Vs. High Temp Dabs

A domeless nail and carb cap is crucial to get that low temperature goodness.

I also believe more healing properties of the oil reach the lungs with a proper low temp dab in comparison to a regular style dab.

I have lung issues and will choke up after a regular temp dab though after a low temp with carb cap goes down smoother even with rougher oil.

Large hot dabs borderline on dangerous if someone is a heavy dabber. Essentially the heat from the nail heats the vapor up enough that it bypasses the glass piece in regards to condensation (reclaim) and settles on the throat/lungs possibly leading to health problems down the road. This can be more pronounced when dabbing lower grade or over purged oils.
